raw.description: 回合开始时，若自身不处于异常状态则当回合自身受到的攻击伤害减少30%，对手使用的攻击技能微弱自身时改为受到的固定伤害、百分比伤害减少30%，若自身处于异常状态则消除对手能力提升状态，消除成功时令对手疲惫|战斗阶段结束时，若当回合自身先制等级与上回合不相等则下回合技能先制+1，高于上回合时恢复自身最大体力的30%，低于上回合时额外解除自身所处的异常状态，与自身本次在场的所有回合均不同时每有1回合不同下回合造成的攻击伤害提升30%|自身位于出战背包时，对方进入附属类异常状态时，己方打开天之门、地之门、神之门中首个未打开的神域之门，回合结束后，若己方其他精灵处于附属类异常状态，则关闭首个未关闭的神域之门|（boss无效）

review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review
review.rationale: 首回合无历史时按用户回答不计算比较/全历史词条，但记录当前真实先制供以后比较；其余在场本人开关门、减伤和技能收益当前验证，真正场下作用延期。
review.singleBehavior: 首回合不授历史比较回血净异/先制或全历史不同增伤；后继回合沿真实记录计算；原有清强疲惫、属性关系红减或非红减、当前开门和选择免PP限制保持。
review.deferredBehavior: 本人真实场下仍在出战背包时的跨精灵对方进入附属开队伍门；己方其他精灵附属使回末关闭首个未关闭门。天门为己方场下所有精灵回复1PP；地门回复场下等量体力；神门向对方场下所有精灵附加等量真实伤害。分别保留原始门术语及版本79e06234/d58a2bec/34b55dc3。
review.trigger: 对方真实进入附属异常、回末己方其他精灵附属、固定或百分比附加被免疫时针对真实场下目标

success.name: 4888全部17招有序实例编译；17招无魂印64种子基础与17招明确上回合0前态原生魂印执行，首回合2436及魂印按已答跳过历史词条
success.assertion: test('4888全部17招有序实例编译；17招无魂印64种子基础与17招明确上回合0前态原生魂印执行，首回合2436及魂印按已答跳过历史词条',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const c=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(c.issue,'');const s=prepared({move:m.id,soul:true,history:[0]});assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]),c.operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]));turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.basePPCostThisUse.amount,1);require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('#4888 base '+m.id);}const s=make({move:38338,soul:true});turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.history.length,1);assert.equal(E.SOULS.registry[2075].partial,false);assert.deepEqual(require('../local-species.cjs').issues(source),[]);});

success.name: 4888真实2075回初无异普通红减30%，微弱对手攻击改为固定百分比减30%而不减真实；命中零伤与MISS独立
success.assertion:
test('4888真实2075回初无异普通红减30%，微弱对手攻击改为固定百分比减30%而不减真实；命中零伤与MISS独立',()=>{for(const weak of[false,true]){const a=prepared({move:38338,soul:true}),b=prepared({move:38338});const move=a.moveDefinitions[key(10716)],plain=b.moveDefinitions[key(10716)];if(weak){move.type='光';plain.type='光';}turn(a,38338,10716);turn(b,38338,10716);const hits=s=>s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.round===2&&e.targetSide===0);const ar=hits(a).find(e=>e.type==='attack'),br=hits(b).find(e=>e.type==='attack');if(weak)assert.equal(ar.settledDamage,br.settledDamage);else{assert.ok(ar.settledDamage>=Math.floor(br.settledDamage*.7)-1);assert.ok(ar.settledDamage<=Math.ceil(br.settledDamage*.7)+1);}const fixed=hits(a).find(e=>e.type==='fixed');assert.equal(fixed.settledDamage,weak?35:50);}
 const s=prepared({move:38338,soul:true});s.moveDefinitions[key(10127)].type='光';observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)for(const type of['fixed','percent','true']){const hp=c.t.hp;c.hurt(c.t,100,'微弱分支非红'+type,type);assert.equal(hp-c.t.hp,type==='true'?100:70);}},()=>turn(s,38338,10127));});

success.name: 4888真实2075回初有异改清敌能力提升，成功疲惫，强化保护或没有提升不触发，回初快照后新异不切换减伤
success.assertion: test('4888真实2075回初有异改清敌能力提升，成功疲惫，强化保护或没有提升不触发，回初快照后新异不切换减伤',()=>{for(const mode of['success','none','protected']){const s=prepared({move:38338,soul:true});s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']=4;if(mode!=='none')s.fighters[1].stages.atk=2;if(mode==='protected')timer(s,1,'强化保护');turn(s,38338,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,mode==='protected'?2:0);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['疲惫'],mode==='success');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.cleanAtStart,false);}const s=prepared({move:38338,soul:true});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.ailment(c.a,'中毒',c.a,false,false,2);},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.cleanAtStart,true);});

success.name: 4888真实2075已有历史比较：提高先制回30%并下回合+1，降低只净异并+1，相等无奖励；与全部历史均不同时按回合数加30%红
success.assertion: test('4888真实2075已有历史比较：提高先制回30%并下回合+1，降低只净异并+1，相等无奖励；与全部历史均不同时按回合数加30%红',()=>{for(const previous of[-1,0,1]){const s=prepared({move:38338,soul:true,hp:1000,previousPriority:previous,history:[previous]});if(previous===1)s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']=4;turn(s,38338,null);const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075;assert.equal(st.nextPriorityRound,previous===0?undefined:3);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,previous===-1?3700:1000);if(previous===1)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒'],undefined);assert.equal(st.nextDamageBoost,previous===0?0:.3);}const s=prepared({move:38338,soul:true,history:[-3,-3,-1]});turn(s,38338,null);assert.ok(Math.abs(s.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.nextDamageBoost-.9)<1e-9);});

success.name: 4888真实2075当前敌新进入附属异常依次开天/地/神之门，控制不打开、重复刷新不重复开、免异失败不开，自身星状态不冒充对方进入
success.assertion: test('4888真实2075当前敌新进入附属异常依次开天/地/神之门，控制不打开、重复刷新不重复开、免异失败不开，自身星状态不冒充对方进入',()=>{for(const mode of['normal','immune']){const s=prepared({move:38338,soul:true});if(mode==='immune')s.fighters[1].counts.immune=3;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){c.ailment(c.a,'星赐',c.a,false,false,2);c.ailment(c.a,'星赐',c.a,false,false,2);c.ailment(c.a,'星哲',c.a,false,false,2);c.ailment(c.a,'星赎',c.a,false,false,2);}},()=>turn(s,38338,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.gates.length,mode==='normal'?3:1);}const own=prepared({move:38338,soul:true});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0){c.ailment(c.a,'星赐',c.a,false,false,2);c.ailment(c.t,'害怕',c.a,false,false,2);}},()=>turn(own));assert.deepEqual(own.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.gates,[]);});

success.name: 4888真实2075每扇门仅令对应个人技能零PP可选可用，不扩展其他技能；源己方场下恢复与伤害明确延期
success.assertion: test('4888真实2075每扇门仅令对应个人技能零PP可选可用，不扩展其他技能；源己方场下恢复与伤害明确延期',()=>{for(let door=0;door<3;door++){const move=[29303,29304,29305][door],s=prepared({move,soul:true});s.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.gates=[door];for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=0;assert.ok(E.availableMoves(s.fighters[0],s.round).includes(key(move)));const other=s.fighters[0].moves.find(k=>k!==key(move));assert.ok(!E.availableMoves(s.fighters[0],s.round).includes(other));turn(s,move,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.basePPCostThisUse.amount,0);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.gates.includes(door));}});

success.name: 4888真实2075双方真实瑞亚：一方予天繁星给自己三附属，只为当前对方开三门；下一轮对称触发，双方门各自保存

success.name: 4888真实2075登场公共异常链也观察对方进入附属；异常清除后再次进入算新事件，首个未打开按门序而非已开数量
success.assertion:
test('4888真实2075登场公共异常链也观察对方进入附属；异常清除后再次进入算新事件，首个未打开按门序而非已开数量',()=>{const old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='battleStart'&&c.a.side===1)c.entryAilment(c.a,'星赐',2,c.a);}};let s;try{s=make({move:38338,soul:true});}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.gates,[0]);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.gateEvents[0].round,1);
 const a=prepared({move:38338,soul:true});a.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.gates=[1];observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){c.ailment(c.a,'星赐',c.a,false,false,2);c.clearAilments(c.a);c.ailment(c.a,'星赐',c.a,false,false,2);}},()=>turn(a));assert.deepEqual(a.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.gates,[1,0,2]);});

test('4888真实2075回初无异普通红减30%，微弱对手攻击改为固定百分比减30%而不减真实；命中零伤与MISS独立',()=>{for(const weak of[false,true]){const a=prepared({move:38338,soul:true}),b=prepared({move:38338});const move=a.moveDefinitions[key(10716)],plain=b.moveDefinitions[key(10716)];if(weak){move.type='光';plain.type='光';}turn(a,38338,10716);turn(b,38338,10716);const hits=s=>s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.round===2&&e.targetSide===0);const ar=hits(a).find(e=>e.type==='attack'),br=hits(b).find(e=>e.type==='attack');if(weak)assert.equal(ar.settledDamage,br.settledDamage);else{assert.ok(ar.settledDamage>=Math.floor(br.settledDamage*.7)-1);assert.ok(ar.settledDamage<=Math.ceil(br.settledDamage*.7)+1);}const fixed=hits(a).find(e=>e.type==='fixed');assert.equal(fixed.settledDamage,weak?35:50);}
 const s=prepared({move:38338,soul:true});s.moveDefinitions[key(10127)].type='光';observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)for(const type of['fixed','percent','true']){const hp=c.t.hp;c.hurt(c.t,100,'微弱分支非红'+type,type);assert.equal(hp-c.t.hp,type==='true'?100:70);}},()=>turn(s,38338,10127));});

interaction.name: 4888真实2075回初有异改清敌能力提升，成功疲惫，强化保护或没有提升不触发，回初快照后新异不切换减伤
interaction.assertion: test('4888真实2075回初有异改清敌能力提升，成功疲惫，强化保护或没有提升不触发，回初快照后新异不切换减伤',()=>{for(const mode of['success','none','protected']){const s=prepared({move:38338,soul:true});s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']=4;if(mode!=='none')s.fighters[1].stages.atk=2;if(mode==='protected')timer(s,1,'强化保护');turn(s,38338,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,mode==='protected'?2:0);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['疲惫'],mode==='success');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.cleanAtStart,false);}const s=prepared({move:38338,soul:true});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.ailment(c.a,'中毒',c.a,false,false,2);},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.cleanAtStart,true);});

interaction.name: 4888真实2075已有历史比较：提高先制回30%并下回合+1，降低只净异并+1，相等无奖励；与全部历史均不同时按回合数加30%红
interaction.assertion: test('4888真实2075已有历史比较：提高先制回30%并下回合+1，降低只净异并+1，相等无奖励；与全部历史均不同时按回合数加30%红',()=>{for(const previous of[-1,0,1]){const s=prepared({move:38338,soul:true,hp:1000,previousPriority:previous,history:[previous]});if(previous===1)s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']=4;turn(s,38338,null);const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075;assert.equal(st.nextPriorityRound,previous===0?undefined:3);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,previous===-1?3700:1000);if(previous===1)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒'],undefined);assert.equal(st.nextDamageBoost,previous===0?0:.3);}const s=prepared({move:38338,soul:true,history:[-3,-3,-1]});turn(s,38338,null);assert.ok(Math.abs(s.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.nextDamageBoost-.9)<1e-9);});

interaction.name: 4888真实2075当前敌新进入附属异常依次开天/地/神之门，控制不打开、重复刷新不重复开、免异失败不开，自身星状态不冒充对方进入
interaction.assertion: test('4888真实2075当前敌新进入附属异常依次开天/地/神之门，控制不打开、重复刷新不重复开、免异失败不开，自身星状态不冒充对方进入',()=>{for(const mode of['normal','immune']){const s=prepared({move:38338,soul:true});if(mode==='immune')s.fighters[1].counts.immune=3;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){c.ailment(c.a,'星赐',c.a,false,false,2);c.ailment(c.a,'星赐',c.a,false,false,2);c.ailment(c.a,'星哲',c.a,false,false,2);c.ailment(c.a,'星赎',c.a,false,false,2);}},()=>turn(s,38338,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.gates.length,mode==='normal'?3:1);}const own=prepared({move:38338,soul:true});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0){c.ailment(c.a,'星赐',c.a,false,false,2);c.ailment(c.t,'害怕',c.a,false,false,2);}},()=>turn(own));assert.deepEqual(own.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.gates,[]);});

interaction.name: 4888真实2075每扇门仅令对应个人技能零PP可选可用，不扩展其他技能；源己方场下恢复与伤害明确延期
interaction.assertion: test('4888真实2075每扇门仅令对应个人技能零PP可选可用，不扩展其他技能；源己方场下恢复与伤害明确延期',()=>{for(let door=0;door<3;door++){const move=[29303,29304,29305][door],s=prepared({move,soul:true});s.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.gates=[door];for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=0;assert.ok(E.availableMoves(s.fighters[0],s.round).includes(key(move)));const other=s.fighters[0].moves.find(k=>k!==key(move));assert.ok(!E.availableMoves(s.fighters[0],s.round).includes(other));turn(s,move,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.basePPCostThisUse.amount,0);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.gates.includes(door));}});

interaction.name: 4888真实2075双方真实瑞亚：一方予天繁星给自己三附属，只为当前对方开三门；下一轮对称触发，双方门各自保存
interaction.assertion: test('4888真实2075双方真实瑞亚：一方予天繁星给自己三附属，只为当前对方开三门；下一轮对称触发，双方门各自保存',()=>{const snapshot=()=>structuredClone(source),ids=[38338,29303,29304,29305,38329],s=E.createBattle({wikiSnapshots:[snapshot(),snapshot()],wikiLoadouts:[ids,ids],criticals:false,builds:[{suit:'none',overrides:{maxHp:9000,atk:180,spa:180,def:300,spd:300,spe:500}},{suit:'none',overrides:{maxHp:9000,atk:180,spa:180,def:300,spd:300,spe:100}}]});s.round=2;for(const f of s.fighters){f.soulState.ria2075.history=[{round:1,priority:0}];f.soulState.previousPriority4888=0;}Object.assign(s,E.resolveTurn(s,[key(29303),key(38338)]));assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.gates,[]);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[1].soulState.ria2075.gates,[0,1,2]);Object.assign(s,E.resolveTurn(s,[key(38338),key(29303)]));assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.gates,[0,1,2]);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[1].soulState.ria2075.gates,[0,1,2]);});

interaction.name: 4888真实2075登场公共异常链也观察对方进入附属；异常清除后再次进入算新事件，首个未打开按门序而非已开数量
interaction.assertion:
test('4888真实2075登场公共异常链也观察对方进入附属；异常清除后再次进入算新事件，首个未打开按门序而非已开数量',()=>{const old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='battleStart'&&c.a.side===1)c.entryAilment(c.a,'星赐',2,c.a);}};let s;try{s=make({move:38338,soul:true});}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.gates,[0]);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.gateEvents[0].round,1);
 const a=prepared({move:38338,soul:true});a.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.gates=[1];observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){c.ailment(c.a,'星赐',c.a,false,false,2);c.clearAilments(c.a);c.ailment(c.a,'星赐',c.a,false,false,2);}},()=>turn(a));assert.deepEqual(a.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.gates,[1,0,2]);});

interaction.name: 4888真实2075已有不同先制历史授下一回合实际+1和按历史条数红增伤，再次重复历史不授新增伤；技能禁疗不封魂印回血
interaction.assertion: test('4888真实2075已有不同先制历史授下一回合实际+1和按历史条数红增伤，再次重复历史不授新增伤；技能禁疗不封魂印回血',()=>{const a=prepared({move:38338,soul:true,hp:1000,previousPriority:-1,history:[-1],loadout:[38338,29312,29304,29305,38329]}),b=prepared({move:38338,loadout:[38338,29312,29304,29305,38329]});timer(a,0,'技能禁疗');turn(a,38338,null);turn(b,38338,null);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].hp,3700);turn(a,38338,null);turn(b,38338,null);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,1);assert.ok(sum(a)>=Math.floor(sum(b)*1.3));assert.ok(sum(a)<=Math.ceil((sum(b)+1)*1.3));const c=prepared({move:38338,soul:true,history:[-1,0,-1]});turn(c,38338,null);assert.equal(c.fighters[0].soulState.ria2075.nextDamageBoost,0);});

success.assertion: test('4888/4全部重复特攻速度命中原参数：决意各一、至灾特攻二及免异48，453清强成功才疲惫',()=>{for(const id of[29312,29315]){const s=make({move:id});turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.spa,id===29312?1:2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.spe,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.acc,1);if(id===29315)assert.ok(s.fighters[0].effects['免异常']);}for(const mode of['success','none','protected']){const s=make(row(453));if(mode!=='none')s.fighters[1].stages.atk=2;if(mode==='protected')timer(s,1,'强化保护');turn(s,s.auditMoveId,null);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['疲惫'],mode==='success');assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,mode==='protected'?2:0);}});

success.name: 4888/699与697本招无视攻击免疫及伤害上限，1533同fb8d03f4已确认差值真实伤害凑阈值300，1625严格高于300才全三

success.assertion: test('4888/4全部重复特攻速度命中原参数：决意各一、至灾特攻二及免异48，453清强成功才疲惫',()=>{for(const id of[29312,29315]){const s=make({move:id});turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.spa,id===29312?1:2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.spe,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.acc,1);if(id===29315)assert.ok(s.fighters[0].effects['免异常']);}for(const mode of['success','none','protected']){const s=make(row(453));if(mode!=='none')s.fighters[1].stages.atk=2;if(mode==='protected')timer(s,1,'强化保护');turn(s,s.auditMoveId,null);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['疲惫'],mode==='success');assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,mode==='protected'?2:0);}});

success.assertion: test('4888/2218三种独立星已持有各强化全一、未持有按1回合施加，1091未击败授下两回反弹而击败不授，574当前自耗与复活后下一用招收益保留',()=>{for(const r of rows(2218)){const args=source.moves.find(m=>m.id===r.move).effectInstances[r.index].args,name=({33:'星赐',34:'星哲',38:'星赎'})[args[1]];for(const held of[false,true]){const s=make(r);if(held)s.fighters[0].ailments[name]=3;let applied;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===0)applied=c.a.ailments[name]>=c.round;},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.atk,held?1:0);assert.equal(applied,true);if(!held&&name!=='星赎')assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments[name],undefined);}}for(const hp of[1,9000]){const s=make({...row(1091),targetHp:hp});turn(s);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[0].effects.reflect,hp===9000);}const s=make({...row(574),loadout:[23108,38338,29312,29305,38329]});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ji574NextSkill,true);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ji574NextLandedCrit,true);});

review.singleBehavior: 本招实际选择后局部忽略对手正速度等级并保持原等级；最终顺序用到该速度比较才记录资格；实际命中执行时同回合同真实用招计数资格触发清回合，保护阻止清除；双防/攻/特攻/命中提升不能单独触发此属性招。

success.name: 4888/2437无敌提升时不误清回合，仅无视实际生效才清回合且不改写为清强；1687控制反弹不挡附属，2196三原生星状态独立施加与免异失败
success.assertion: test('4888/2437无敌提升时不误清回合，仅无视实际生效才清回合且不改写为清强；1687控制反弹不挡附属，2196三原生星状态独立施加与免异失败',()=>{const a=make(row(2437));turn(a,a.auditMoveId,null);assert.ok(a.fighters[1].effects['攻击必中']);const b=make(row(2437));b.fighters[1].stages.def=1;turn(b);assert.equal(b.fighters[1].stages.def,1);assert.ok(b.fighters[1].effects['攻击必中']);const control=make(row(1687));observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){c.ailment(c.t,'害怕',c.a,false,false,2);c.ailment(c.t,'星赐',c.a,false,false,2);}},()=>turn(control));assert.equal(control.fighters[0].ailments['害怕'],undefined);assert.ok(control.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']);assert.ok(control.fighters[0].ailments['星赐']);for(const r of rows(2196)){const s=make(r);turn(s);const name=({33:'星赐',34:'星哲',38:'星赎'})[source.moves.find(m=>m.id===r.move).effectInstances[r.index].args[1]];assert.ok(s.fighters[0].ailments[name]);const immune=make(r);immune.fighters[0].counts.immune=1;turn(immune);assert.equal(immune.fighters[0].ailments[name],undefined);}});

success.assertion: test('4888/433四回合逐回全一、1462原四回合用招固定300无强时600，615低体严格小于三分一回满与技能禁疗',()=>{const a=make({...row(433),loadout:[29304,38338,29315,29305,38329]});turn(a,a.auditMoveId,null);for(const k of keys)assert.equal(a.fighters[0].stages[k],1);turn(a,38338,null);for(const k of keys)assert.equal(a.fighters[0].stages[k],2);for(const boosted of[false,true]){const s=make(row(1462));if(boosted)s.fighters[0].stages.atk=1;turn(s,s.auditMoveId,null);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),boosted?300:600);}for(const [hp,want]of[[2999,9000],[3000,3300]]){const s=make({...row(615),hp});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,want);}const ban=make({...row(615),hp:2999});timer(ban,0,'技能禁疗');turn(ban,ban.auditMoveId,null);assert.equal(ban.fighters[0].hp,2999);});

success.assertion: test('4888/2098下两回合先制按真实本回合阈值-3与原生负先制计算、到期，2205异常时克制取双向最大，713按实际提升段数X30',()=>{const s=make({...row(2098),loadout:[29304,38338,29315,29305,38329]});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,null);for(let r=2;r<=4;r++){turn(s,38338,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,r<=3?3:0);}const a=make({...row(713),aStats:{spa:180}});a.fighters[0].stages.atk=2;a.fighters[0].stages.acc=3;turn(a);assert.equal(sum(a,'fixed'),150);const b=make(row(2205));b.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤']=3;let observed;const old=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...old,run(p,o,c){const r=old.run(p,o,c);if(p==='beforeDamage'&&c.a.side===0)observed={actual:c.affinity,want:Math.max(c.typeAffinity(c.a.type,c.t.type),c.typeAffinity(c.t.type,c.a.type))};return r;}};try{turn(b);}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=old;}assert.equal(observed.actual,observed.want);});

为自身附加1回合的星赐，若自身已处于星赐则改为全属性+1
为自身附加1回合的星哲，若自身已处于星哲则改为全属性+1
为自身附加1回合的星赎，若自身已处于星赎则改为全属性+1

success.assertion: test('4888/2098下两回合先制按真实本回合阈值-3与原生负先制计算、到期，2205异常时克制取双向最大，713按实际提升段数X30',()=>{const s=make({...row(2098),loadout:[29304,38338,29315,29305,38329]});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,null);for(let r=2;r<=4;r++){turn(s,38338,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,r<=3?3:0);}const a=make({...row(713),aStats:{spa:180}});a.fighters[0].stages.atk=2;a.fighters[0].stages.acc=3;turn(a);assert.equal(sum(a,'fixed'),150);const b=make(row(2205));b.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤']=3;let observed;const old=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...old,run(p,o,c){const r=old.run(p,o,c);if(p==='beforeDamage'&&c.a.side===0)observed={actual:c.affinity,want:Math.max(c.typeAffinity(c.a.type,c.t.type),c.typeAffinity(c.t.type,c.a.type))};return r;}};try{turn(b);}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=old;}assert.equal(observed.actual,observed.want);});

success.assertion: test('4888/2098下两回合先制按真实本回合阈值-3与原生负先制计算、到期，2205异常时克制取双向最大，713按实际提升段数X30',()=>{const s=make({...row(2098),loadout:[29304,38338,29315,29305,38329]});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,null);for(let r=2;r<=4;r++){turn(s,38338,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,r<=3?3:0);}const a=make({...row(713),aStats:{spa:180}});a.fighters[0].stages.atk=2;a.fighters[0].stages.acc=3;turn(a);assert.equal(sum(a,'fixed'),150);const b=make(row(2205));b.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤']=3;let observed;const old=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...old,run(p,o,c){const r=old.run(p,o,c);if(p==='beforeDamage'&&c.a.side===0)observed={actual:c.affinity,want:Math.max(c.typeAffinity(c.a.type,c.t.type),c.typeAffinity(c.t.type,c.a.type))};return r;}};try{turn(b);}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=old;}assert.equal(observed.actual,observed.want);});

success.assertion: test('4888/2218三种独立星已持有各强化全一、未持有按1回合施加，1091未击败授下两回反弹而击败不授，574当前自耗与复活后下一用招收益保留',()=>{for(const r of rows(2218)){const args=source.moves.find(m=>m.id===r.move).effectInstances[r.index].args,name=({33:'星赐',34:'星哲',38:'星赎'})[args[1]];for(const held of[false,true]){const s=make(r);if(held)s.fighters[0].ailments[name]=3;let applied;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===0)applied=c.a.ailments[name]>=c.round;},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.atk,held?1:0);assert.equal(applied,true);if(!held&&name!=='星赎')assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments[name],undefined);}}for(const hp of[1,9000]){const s=make({...row(1091),targetHp:hp});turn(s);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[0].effects.reflect,hp===9000);}const s=make({...row(574),loadout:[23108,38338,29312,29305,38329]});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ji574NextSkill,true);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ji574NextLandedCrit,true);});
